text: Amazing. I was very pleased with my stay. The staff was excellent, the cleanliness was top-notch, and the air fresheners were elegant and refreshing. I would also like to thank the ladies who served breakfast;Mavis ,Alice,Sandra they were wonderful, friendly, and very elegant. If I return to Ghana, this hotel will definitely be my place of residence. Thank you from the bottom of my heart

Detailed, friendly and memorable. I am a platinum Marriott member, and my two night stay at Kempinski has made me consider, for the first time, Kempinski brand hotels for the various locations that I travel to. I was impressed with the level of detail I experienced. From the time I checked in, I noted the attendant’s proper training in not stating the room number out loud. As a female traveler, I find that particular security measure is often times disregarded. When I made my reservation, I had casually noted that it was my birthday and was pleasantly surprised when my room was beautifully decorated and included a bottle of wine and a beautiful chocolate cake. Every staff person I engaged throughout my stay asked me how my birthday weekend was going —a very nice touch. It is the small details that make a huge difference and elevates brands and this attention to detail has placed Kempinski on my radar for future stays elsewhere. Thank you for a restful and enjoyable stay!
Great service - always. Really great service in the lounge, Enzo, Ernest and Godwin @ the executive lounge are always attentive, professional and always go the extra mile

Great venue for business meeting. Kempinski Hotel was a perfect venue for our business meeting. We had 70 people from 6 countries attend this meeting, and the Kempinski provided us with excellent service and a wonderful meeting room. Would highly recommend them for any conference!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Fantastic Food, Atmosphere and Service. While visiting the Gold Coast to visit my son, I had the opportunity to catch up with a friend's son and his partner. We wanted somewhere a little different where we could relax, enjoy a good meal and catch up on everyone's travels and future plans. Shiraz Persian Restaurant & Bar was the perfect choice. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, the staff were friendly and attentive, and nothing seemed to be too much trouble. The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavour and beautifully presented. A big thank you to the team for helping make our evening such a success. It was a memorable night shared with great company, excellent food and outstanding hospitality. I would happily recommend Shiraz to anyone visiting Surfers Paradise and looking for something a little different from the usual dining options. Thanks again to all the staff for a wonderful experience

An elegant afternoon tea. The Truffe Afternoon Tea at the Palm Court was a wonderful experience. The ambiance was elegant and surroundings spacious. We were very well looked after by Sydney, a charming young woman who made our stay very comfortable with her attention to detail. There was much artistry in the delicious savoury and sweet items

Double Barrel Kitchen has lost it great chefs and standard god help us. 4 friends came for lunch with our recommendation , I had the prawn linguini which came out lukewarm warm, Staff looked at me as if i was a burden to them, i asked the waitress to tell the chef to heat it , they put it in the microwave to heat up, the sauce was tasteless and looked very unappetising it was just tomato sauce prawn and pasta 3 ingredients $32 I couldn't finish it , my friend had the Salmon bowl which the salmon was over cooked and dry the rice underneath was hard and with lumpy clusters she only had a few bites and could not eat it anymore, the new owner was very unapologetic and would not offer anything else in good faith he paid no heed to our complaints ,our other friends meals were very ordinary but they didn't bother to complain due to the cold shoulder of the owner, he said the restaurants food is the best and never received any complaints, hard to believe? double barrel was a leading restaurant in the area since 2020 i was a patron and went for the great coffee and great food, it looks like that legacy is gone for good, i have been in the hospitality industry for decades owned my own businesses i would never treat a customer as i was , I never experienced such a disappointment i will never go back there. Double barrel i wish you well for the future

I had a disappointing experience at Labadi Beach Hotel.. The hotel felt overbooked and overpriced for the level of service provided. The biggest issue was at reception, where the staff were not particularly helpful and repeatedly blamed a lack of access to their system for two days instead of offering practical solutions or keeping guests informed. The most frustrating part was returning to find that I had been locked out of my room while I was away. This situation could have been avoided with better communication and proper guest management. Throughout my stay, communication was poor, and I was left feeling that my concerns were not taken seriously. Labadi Beach Hotel has a great location and beautiful grounds, but the customer service and communication need significant improvement to match the premium rates charged

Our Labadi beach hotel honeymoon experience. We had an amazing experience from the moment we contacted labadi beach hotel through Email and phone call. The enquiry was very welcoming and the booking was seamless. That aside, our arrival to the hotel was amazing as we were ushered in to the cozy reception area and the reception, “Florence” on glasses attended to us scanning our passports…when we got to our room on the first floor using the lift, we were surprised to be welcomed with rose petals from the door area into the main room area and even the rest room area. Above all, the bed with a neatly dressed white bedsheet was decorated with red and gold rose petals with the inscription “Forever Urs”. This swept us off our feet and in the next few minutes a knock on the door and the room attendant showed up with 2 complimentary wines and some fruits free from the hotel to celebrate us as newly married couple. … the next couple of days we’re unforgettable: from the amazing buffet breakfast, the beach side experience, the well equipped gym, multiple clean pools and the ride to the airport provided by the hotel all inclusive in your booking. All the staff we encountered were so professional, humble, focused, empathic, always smiling, and ever willing to assist whenever you ask for guidance. You can never go wrong trying the Labadi experience ☺️❤️

Fresh beddings Bathrooms are spic and span I expressed my appreciation to the housekeeping supervisor Freda for ensuring that the rooms are clean. If you want to dine in,in style then the various meal outlets from room service, outside restaurant near the beach area,main restaurant or relaxing at the Lagoon bar, Susan and her colleagues will serve you sumptuous meals. The pizza bar is amazing. When you check in to the hotel,your offered a cold glass of juice. Be sure not to skip breakfast in the morning. Thank you Labadi Beach Hotel for a great experience

Enjoyable stay at Labadi Beach hotel. Always a pleasure to stay there , excellent location and great staff eager to serve their guests , nice outlets whether bars and main restaurant as well as a beautiful pool area with two swimming pools and beach access

Labadi Pleasure Beach in Accra is a popular, lively, and crowded beach known for its energetic atmosphere, beach parties. I always make sure to visit La Pleasure Beach in Ghana. It is a place that has a great atmosphere, lots of music, food, drinks and best of all the wonderful sea. The day I went was Easter Monday, and it was extremely busy. It did not take long for us to get in. We had to purchase tickets at the entrance, and we received free drinks on entry. There are numerous people trying to direct you to a table, but there is lots of choice. Once seated, vendors selling various things will approach you to buy something. A simple refusal will normally suffice. La Pleasure Beach is an institution, and not having visited for more than three years, I was not disappointed on my return. I will definitely be coming back as always. Highly recommended

DO NOT GO // Avoid LaBadia Big Mama Kitchen Special. DO NOT, and I really mean: DO NOT! go to La Bodi Big Mamas Kitchen at Labodi Beach. They will lure you in, be all nice and smiley and bring you a menu with no listed prices. Then you ask for the dish with tuna and ask how much it will cost. The answer: is 100 Cedis. You figure, alright then we are at a moderate place and the Tilapia with beans will not be much more. Beer is expensive, but the view is stunning. Half an hour later you get informed that there is no tuna. You opt for the cassava fish on the menu. While you are waiting about 20 people start talking to you and trying to sell things. After 1,5 hours you ask about the food: it is in the making is the answer. After two hours you ask about it again: 10 more minutes. The food arrives. While eating you get offered driving services from the weed smoking gang sitting at the next table. You finish and go pay. You expect something around 500 Cedi. Imagine the shock, when two people having some drinks and two meals are supposed to pay 1100 Cedi. So, 100 Euro is really too much money for the food served. Upon asking we were told that the cassava fish is an expensive one. But they also charged 350 Cedi for Tilapia with beans. So we asked how come he did not mention the higher price when we switched from tuna to the other fish: Ma‘am you only asked the price for the tuna and for nothing else. It is a TOTAL RIP OFF. The gang sitting next to us also belonged to that crowd of the kitchen as did several of the street vendors. We managed to get the price down by discussing hard and stressing, that there no prices on the menu. The answer to that was: we had one with prices, but it got lost. My educated guess is: they use the ones without prices for foreigners and the other for Ghanaians. That was one of the most bitter experiences. Please spread the word

Not clean. This beach is accessed through a paid entrance. About 100 metres on either side of the entrance,the beach is quite good. Farther down it is covered with plastic muck, thin black bags, bottles and food wrap. Completely ruins the beach. We were there at 11 am on a weekday. The beach was deserted except for a couple of others. There are many seaside restaurants with hundreds of wooden chairs, so perhaps the place is filled at certain times. We left in half hour. Don't go to Big Mama Special at Labodi Beach. Do not go to Big Mama Special they will triple charge if they know you're foreign. They charged us 1400 CIDIS equivalent to 140.00 usd. The drinks were watered down. No prices on the menu. We had to speak with beach management to only to find out this is an ongoing issue. We got three drinks with hardly no alcohol. Management refunded us 20.00. We will never go back

Accra's former premier beach.. Don't expect luxury or serenity. Labadi Beach is "just" a lively African city beach with great music, great food and all Ghanaian experience. You want a quiet visit, go early leave before 2 PM, you want the typical Ghanaian youth experience, go when the sun goes down. For a more peaceful Accra Beach experience visit next doors La Boma Beach

I wouldn’t go again 😣. I went during Christmas week with family. I would not return again 1) you are constantly hassled on entry by people trying to get you to visit their bar. The sand is covered in discarded litter, witnessed a worker clear a table by just pushing dirty plates onto the sand 3) the horses stink 4) the sea is polluted If you don’t mind the above and want a party atmosphere then it may be for you but it was not for me

Used to be lovely now it's filthy .Avoid!. Sadly, Labadi beach has deteriorated over the years. We've been coming to Ghana since the 90s and the beach used to be clean and pleasant with a relaxed vibe. Over the past 8 or so years, it has steadily been going downhill. On our trip in December 2023, we decided to go for old times sakes and hoping since lockdown things would have improved. Sadly, no. I didn't dare go into the water as there was plastic, empty toothpaste tubes, bottles and even condoms strewn over the beach. I don't know what the entrance fee of 20GHC is for. It's such a shame that it's being mismanaged. Accra has a lovely coast line but there's no thought of preserving its beauty or creating aspace that is enjoyable, Shame

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Outstanding Hotel Stay – Highly Recommend. I recently stayed at the hotel and had a wonderful experience from check-in to checkout. The room was spotless, beautifully appointed, and incredibly comfortable — the bed was one of the best I’ve slept in while traveling. Everything worked perfectly, from the modern bathroom to the reliable Wi-Fi and quiet location. The service throughout my stay was exceptional. The housekeeping team did a fantastic job keeping the room fresh every day. What truly stood out, however, was reception. Greeted with a warm, genuine smile and handled everything efficiently and professionally. Alisa was attentive, double-checked my bill, answered all my questions patiently, and even offered helpful recommendations that made my departure smoother. Her positive energy and personal touch turned a routine checkout into a highlight of my stay. The entire staff was friendly and accommodating, the facilities were well-maintained, and the overall atmosphere made me feel truly valued as a guest. I’ll definitely be returning on my next trip and will be asking for Alisa by name if she’s on duty! Thank you to Alisa and the whole team for making my stay memorable. L'accueil et le confort à Accra. Quel beau séjour dans ce bel hôtel et immense qui n'a pas le design le plus moderne mais reste très joli. Il est situé dans un quartier calme d'Accra, même les travaux d'extension de l'hôtel ne se font pas entendre. L'accueil et service avec le sourire sont un plus comparé à d'autres établissements du continent. L'hôtel est immense et pareil pour la chambre avec le jacuzzi bien séparé de la salle de bains, les bouteilles d'eau offertes, le room service était parfait et les employés sympathiques. On peut vivre en autarcie dans l'hôtel avec un petit déjeuner continental au-dessus de la moyenne avec un large choix des céréales, jus de fruits, yaourts, fruits sans oublier les plats salés du riz, spaghettis aux poissons frits. Une belle piscine et des salles de conférences partout, Si vous venez à Accra, l'Alisa hôtel est un lieu chaleureux et remplis de visiteurs du monde entier. A recommander

text: The perfect Vacation. The Royal Senchi is your best vacation destination anytime of the year. The serene atmosphere, the ambiance alone…I enjoyed Scrumptious meals too, especially the breakfast 😋… I had a nice experience! 😍

place_name: The Royal Senchi Hotel and Resort
text: An Excellent City escape. Beautiful scenery and excellent customer experience. Enjoyed the breakfast with lots of variety for everyone

place_name: The Royal Senchi Hotel and Resort
text: Assessment of facility. The facilities at the hotel are very good, courteous staff, good breakfast and excellent and clean room

place_name: The Royal Senchi Hotel and Resort
text: Beautiful family getaway with amazing food and peaceful atmosphere. We had a wonderful family stay at The Royal Senchi. The environment was peaceful, beautiful, and perfect for relaxation. The rooms were very comfortable, clean, and we had some of the best sleep we’ve had in a long time. The food was also really good throughout our stay, and the staff were warm and welcoming. We especially appreciated that the restaurant provided a high chair for our 6-month-old baby during meals. That thoughtful gesture meant a lot to us as parents. The only small issue was that the chair was entirely plastic and not very comfortable for him, so he kept crying while seated in it. A little cushioning or foam padding would make a big difference for families with babies. Aside from that minor detail, everything else was excellent and we truly enjoyed our stay. We would definitely visit again

place_name: The Royal Senchi Hotel and Resort
text: Feedback on Royal Senchi Experience. Overall, my stay was excellent. Staff, rooms, meals and conference faculties were top notch. the scenery was very relaxing

place_name: The Royal Senchi Hotel and Resort
text: Peace and Tranquillity...Destroyed!. If you enjoy listening to thumping bass music from the next door hotel as you relax by the lovely pool, or observe the birds swooping over the gently flowing, idyllic Volta, then this is the place for you. Likewise if you enjoy having to shout at your family or the waiting staff to make yourself heard over the cacophony that is the mealtime musical 'entertainment', then this hotel will meet your needs very well. Furthermore, if you enjoy having your patience exercised whilst questioning why you paid so much for the hotel, then the 90 - 120 minute wait for a meal from the a la carte menu will give you ample opportunity, as you cower down by the river to escape the noise, bitterly regretting forgetting to pack your noise cancelling headphones, you will love it here. All of the above I experienced over the Easter weekend. It would appear that as well as being at capacity for overnight guests, the hotel opens its doors to any number of day visitors, which swell the numbers looking to eat way beyond the capacity of the restaurant and waiting staff, leading to long delays, food served cold, tables not getting cleared and rubbish lying on the floor for extended periods as there is no one to clear up. On the positive side, the setting is fantastic, noise aside - seriously consider noise cancelling headphones if you are thinking of staying. The staff are generally professional and courteous and the rooms are well appointed. There were several issues with our room, but once reported they were rectified pretty much straight away. And when I asked to speak to the management on departure, the individual I spoke to was considerate of the issues we had experienced, but it was obvious that the complaints we had made during the stay had not reached management level despite engaging frequently with various levels of staff. By all means go ahead and book a stay here, but be prepared!!

place_name: The Royal Senchi Hotel and Resort
text: family trip. Great place. Bad food and service. Come, but bring your own food... otherwise you'll stay hungry sarvice is POOR. you can wait more then 3 hours to recive your order at the Pool Bar

The best days are over. The small garden, located directly on the Volta River, is a small oasis. Eating there requires a lot of patience as you have to wait a long time for breakfast, lunch or dinner. The worst thing, however, was the room. You can only advise against spending the night there! The condition of the room was catastrophic. The sofa upholstery is broken, the bed linen has big holes, the TV screen was only half functional, the bathroom was completely shattered, lamps had to be organized, because only one little lamp was shining in that room. And the AC blowed right on the bed. A renovation would be urgently needed here if one wants to continue to welcome tourists

Adi lake Resort Staycation. Adi lake Resort. My stay at ADI Lake Resort in Akosombo was absolutely amazing! From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with warm hospitality and a breathtaking view of the serene Volta Lake. The resort’s location, nestled amidst lush greenery and overlooking the tranquil waters, provided the perfect backdrop for a peaceful getaway How To Get There. From Madina or Tema station, board a troski heading to Akosombo. Alight at Akosombo and then pick a taxi to the resort. Alternatively, you can walk from the Akosombo bus stop to the resort. How much does a room cost? Ready for a weekend getaway? Like , comment , share, follow . 😍

Beware of this Resort . Full of rowdies and hotel management encourages that. I had a confirmed booking ( mail from Resort Management Mr.Cecil ,confirming the same) for Checkin on 2nd and Checkout on 3rd Jan 2022 . I went to the Resort at 11 am with my wife only to be told that the Challet Room ( the one I booked ) will be free at 2pm . I agreed to it and took a boat ride over River Volta and came back at 1:30pm to the Resort. This was the beginning of the nightmare . Mr. Cecil then comes back to me and says that the guests that the "guests" who were occupying the Challet Room have denied to vacate the room and he wanted to shift us to a different room of lower category which I denied . Then Mr. Cecil spoke to the so called " guests" to convince them . These guests ( 3 male members) had a liquor bottle in their hands and were thoroughly intoxicated . They got infuriated , started abusing us as "Fu***** foreigners go to hell , who the f*** asked you to come to Ghana " The abuses hurled towards us went for a very long time as we were having coffee beside the lake . I wanted to call the Police , the hotel management kneeled down and pleaded me not to do the same .Neither did they do something about the rowdy "guests"...In a way they seemed to be hand in glove . I took my money and walked out . If you don't want to be abused , never ever go to this property and spend your money .It is a nightmare which I have never faced before . BE CAREFUL WHEN YOU BOOK THIS HOTEL ....WORST EXPERIENCE YOU CAN EVER DREAM OF !!!

Great affordable accomadation. The view from my room was gorgeous. Right on the Volta river overlooking the Adomi Bridge. Adi Lake Resort is quiet and serene. I would recommend this place for those looking for a budget-friendly place

Lovely situation. Stayed here for one night as part of a 5 day birding trip. Lovely situation on the bank of Lake Volta. The lake itself and the surroundings were very clean and unpolluted. The resort- which consisted of about 10? rooms around some gardens, plus a restaurant and bar, was very quiet. The staff seemed willing and friendly. We went on a long canoe trip from the resort, down to the Akosombo dam - very calm and beautiful and saw a lot of birds

Hidden Gem. I have now stayed at Adi Lake Resort twice, and both times I have been extremely satisfied with my visit. The rooms are comfortable, and nicely spaced to ensure a quiet atmosphere. The location is close enough to major roads to be easy to get to, but still quiet. The hotel opens up on to the Volta lake, and has a superb view of the Adomi bridge. Very clean, with attentive staff

Beautiful location, great food and good rooms. Spent two restful days at hotel including breakfast. We also chose to have evening meal. Excellent food with local menu and catered for vegetarians (local menu without meat). Views are wonderful and had breakfast overlooking bridge and river. Bedrooms are basic but comfortable. Visit again. Yes

a quiet places wit nice views. the room was pretty spacious and clean. the bed was comfortable too and nice toliets too. it seems to be a bit run down however. the staff are friendly and accomadating. food is pretty good and nice. in the morning,u can relax people watching go on their daily life,fishermen fishing, women watching their clothes beside the resort. the wifi is only pretty strong at the dining area only

Pretty views. Stayed for one night at the resort. Very natural and rustic surroundings though the resort has certainly seen better days. Nevertheless the staff is friendly and responsive. Good views of Lake Volta and fishermen passing by in their boats. Good for a short term stay

Good potential. Rough around the edges.. This property is well located and provides a relaxing atmosphere. I would consider the rooms clean with room for improvement. The problems I encountered here were of little consequence individually but collectively they paint a picture of inconsistent service and a serious lack of a proper maintenance program. It often appeared that everything was in a state of disrepair and management was either uninterested in address things or lacking the teeth to get the staff to do so. The food is basic and good but lacking a little finesse. I would recommend this property for a short stay but you would be best served by not setting your expectations too high

Beautiful Grounds Overlooking the Atlantic Ocean, a View Both Majestic and Solemn!. Our travel group of 35 people stayed 2 nights at the Coconut Grove Beach Resort in Elmina during our cultural expedition of Ghana in June 2026. The size of our group didn’t slow the staff down at all. We arrived late in the evening while it was raining. The staff sprang into action. They helped to unload our luggage from the bus, provided room assignments then assisted with delivering the luggage to our rooms. We were impressed by the efficiency of their service. The rooms were both spacious and very clean, making our stay comfortable. The shower was in a separate room from the toilet and sink however this was not an issue for us. We did have some initial challenges in connecting to the internet however the staff assisted us with that. The TV had limited stations but again, not an issue. The next morning revealed the full beauty of the grounds. The sight of the Atlantic waves was energizing, yet sobering, as we reflected on the ancestors who were taken across those waters—so many never making it to the new world. Some workers were gathering coconuts from the trees, while others were casting nets into the ocean. When we asked what they were doing, they explained that they were catching fish for the meals on the menu. It gave a whole new meaning to enjoying “fresh fish” with our meal. The dishes were good and flavorful, with several options available. We had a view of the ocean with each meal. We did tour the Elmina Castle and other nearby sights. Due to our short stay, we did not get to fully appreciate all that the Coconut Grove Beach Resort had to offer. Despite this, we can recommend this property as a place to stay if you are in this area of the Cape Coast

Coconut grove beach resort Elmina February 2026. Staff were wonderful and beach lovely plus food was delicious. Rooms were clean. I did not like that the beds were single beds jointed to double but it was not bad. Toilet and shower rooms were separate which is good for 2 people . It will be nice if a sink is put in the shower room so you do not have to go to the toilet to clean your teeth

Beautiful Coconut Grove Beach Resort. We love Coconut Grove Beach Resort. We stay there everytime we come to Cape Coast. The grounds are beautiful, the rooms are extremely clean, and the staff is simply delightful

Surrounded by coconut palms. This is a lovely and relaxing resort in Ghana. Is located in a private area requiring a taxi or your own car. it is quite close to the Elmina Castle which requires a visit. We had a private walking tour of the village with Felix, who did a great job of giving us insights to the local culture. Staff of the resort was very friendly and willing to please. The coconut palms throughout the resort are extraordinary. And they provide coconuts for your drinking enjoyment. The rooms are comfortable and the air conditioning refreshing. Overall, very relaxing experience and a great place to stay if one is interested in visiting the Elmina Castle

A piece of paradise near the main coastal tourist attractions. Just a wonderfully relaxed place to base yourself after the hustle and bustle of Ghana. Incredibly friendly staff and an amazing location on the beachfront. Wonderful breakfast and amazingly comfortable room. everything works. Only downside is the length of time that food takes to be delivered, but once you’re used to it you realise it’s just Ghana time.!

Absolute heaven!. This hotel is beautiful, absolutely stunning grounds, lovely food, spotless room. Staff very friendly and a perfect stay, I came with friends after visiting the Kakum national park and Elmina castle. We had a lovely, relaxing time and wish we could have stayed longer but we only had the weekend! The private beach was so sandy and luscious, and there’s a beautiful shop a few minutes up the beach. Felt so content and safe there. Our villa overlooked the beach and it’s just the most wonderful sea view I felt so lucky to have been able to spent time here. Thank you so so much. I’d come back in a heartbeat! The fresh coconuts were divine!

Family fun and relaxation amid the coconut trees by the sea.. This was the most restful, idyllic place we’ve ever stayed. So quiet and peaceful and yet so festive and fun without being jarring or loud at the pool setting. The food is delicious and the staff is the most helpful, friendly and welcoming group of people you could ever want to meet. Rose, Daniel, Michael and everyone there were just the best. Can’t wait to come back!

A quick but lovely stop by. Excellent service and Sarkinah in receptionen is "10 staar employee" and the view is amazing 👏 swimming 🏊‍♀️ in the guinea bay is perfect and a good breakfast was included. Indoor pool wa warm and cousi We will come back soon. Best Regards Johan and Lotta Finland

Great and wonderful ✨. I stumbled upon Coconut Grove Beach Resort, and boy, am I glad I did! This hidden gem boasts an incredible beach, delicious local cuisine, and comfortable rooms with breathtaking ocean views. The resort's animal sanctuary and kids' activities made it an ideal spot for families. We'll definitely be back

Excellent expérience. Excellent beds and food ! Very smpathetic staff and very nice rooms. To reach excellence, some doors may need maintenance in order not to touch the floor and some fans are noisy. Easy to upgrade I think. I recommend strongly to anyone who wants a peaceful rest in Ghana

One of the top places we stayed in Ghana. We were in the budget area of the hotel, which is a short walk down the road from the main area. You still have access to all the amenities (except in-room wifi, we had to go to the main area for wifi access). We had a nice, comfortable stay here. The room and bathroom are both nicely decorated and look like they are built with quality in mind. The main area of the hotel is lovely with a relaxing an inviting pool, a clean and well-maintained beach area, a few little attractions like a stable and rabbit hutch (etc), and the restaurant and bar were well-staffed with friendly, hospitable people. This was the place where we experienced the best customer-oriented hospitality in all of Ghana (and we stayed some nights at the Royal Senchi, so I feel like that's saying a lot). They were not always stocked to meet all guest requests (they ran out of various drink ingredients and also dinner ingredients that we tried to order) but they were friendly and apologetic about it rather than gruff or annoyed. The village rooms are in the style of a thatch cottage and they are duplexes so we did hear a fair bit from the family on the other side of the wall but luckily they were considerate and were not loud after hours

Nice location, but slow service. The overall experience was ok, the room was simple, but clean even though the water was cold. The location was the best thing, really close to the beach and only 15 minutes from the Elmina Castle. The major issue was the service, we waited almost one hour to get the food at the restaurant and 30 minutes for a drink. The breakfast buffet was not really good, but still acceptable

Just ok.... I can't add much to the existing reviews. The property has a lot of maintenance issues, the staff are generally apathetic and the food is average. The location is nice but while I don't have any concrete examples I think finding a similar but superior property is easily possible

Simple with flaws. I don't mind not having a TV. However, I expect a stable water supply and a clean environment. Latter has been given. The water supply has been interrupted in compare. The village however is peaceful. Just ensure not to stay to close to the wall since my sleep has been interrupted by fast driving cars during the night. I was surprised that the wall has no electric fence which seems to be a standard in Ghana

Too expensive. For $135 I expected to have hot water, rooms smell stale and sweaty. The mini bar was empty. We were served hot dogs for sausages at breakfast. The general decor of the huts are mediocre and there were quite a few flies. Wonderful sea breeze and view of the Gulf of Guinea. More work needs to be done. Staff were friendly

Cheaper option but questionable 'value for money'. Spend two nights with family 5 persons in two rooms in the African village at USD 75 per night (USD 95 with additional bed). Disappointed with the location way out of the resort compound. The African Village appeared deserted with some building materials dominating the entrance of the compound. Though we had asked for an additional bed in booking it took 4 hours and several 10 min. walk to reception until they finally came brought it. Same story with our request for extra towels since the standard is only one towel per guest. Rooms were clean but matras not good and db. bed rather short. The room standard is VERY basic e.g. only one bedside lamp and not even TV is standard (even though there were some old poor working TV sets in rooms). There is neither any telephone for contacting reception. The restaurant is VERY slowly. Wifi on and off - not good

Best place I've been in Ghana!. I LOVED this place! It's so nice that if you stay in the village, they give you acces to the pool and private beach of the Coconut Grove Resort as well! The rooms are big, great beds and AC. Really clean as well. The pool and beach are just amazing, as well as the surroundings. It's really quiet, great for relaxing. The only thing that annoyed me was the waiting time for the food, it takes sooo long! But overall I had an amazing time there!

Very basic out of season. Coconut grove is in a lovely beach location once you have made it up the dirt road to the hotel. This was obviously out of season as it was brutally quiet. The village rooms are very basic our shower was hanging off the wall and we were kept company by our friendly lizard who ran around the room. The bar staff looked as if they couldn't be bothered with anything other than watching the tv in the bar. On the Sunday when we went to order another drink from the bar the barman went off on one saying how he wasn't serving anymore. Food was okay took a while to get food out waiters were good and attentive. breakfast I thought it was poor the choices were very limited. So much potential to be really good but Don't feel I would recommend staying here at the moment

Best bang for your buck. We had a wonderful 5 night stay in the Village at Coconut Grove Beach Resort. If you value saving money over a large, luxurious room, then the Village is definitely the move. You have access to all of the same resort amenities that hotel guests have, including the pool, the restaurant (with free breakfast), free wifi, horseback riding, the crocodile pond, the golf course, and the beach with a lifeguard. The rooms in the Village have air conditioning and hot water, so the only thing you'd be missing is a refrigerator - which, if you've spent much time in Ghana, you'd know most of them don't work anyways. I felt that both myself and my belongings were safe at the resort, and the hotel staff were welcoming and accommodating. The hotel arranged pricy Accra airport transportation, as well as transportation for day trips to the Cape Coast Castle, Elmina Castle and Kakum National Park. My only big complaint is that the restaurant and bar staff were very slow providing bills for meals - they also lacked a system for tracking who had and had not paid. We would pay one person for our meal, and another waiter would come up to us 15 minutes later asking if we had paid. It got to the point where it sounded accusatory and I left most meals angry. They even put two beers that we had paid for on our room - which we had to argue off when we paid the total bill. Also the wifi in our rooms wouldn't work on our computers but worked very well on our phones - it was weird. The only other semi-negative thing worth noting is that the door to our room had huge cracks to the outside where multiple lizards entered throughout the day/night

Relaxing stay for break week. We stayed in the Village at the Coconut Grove Beach Resort for 5 nights. Though we didn't stay in the resort, we had access to all the facilities, pool and restaurant. Our cottage had everything we wanted- air conditioning, a large double bed, a shower with hot water, and wifi. There was also a TV in the room. There was room service daily with fresh towels and cleaning. Two water bottles were left in the room per day. A breakfast buffet is included with the price of the room, and has a pretty good selection. The best things are done by 9:30am so it's better to go early. For lunch and dinner, the restaurant is a bit expensive. The food was not great, but also not bad. The drinks at the bar were expensive. Stumble inn, down the beach to the right, has cocktails for only 10 cedis. The pool was lovely, and we went every day. Towels are provided there. The staff were very attentive. Other activities include horse riding for 20 cedis, watching the crocodile feeding, and a small golf course. The resort is close to Kakum National Park, Cape Coast, and the castle in Elmina. The hotel helped us arrange a driver who took us to these three destinations in one day for $65. He also drove us from the airport in Accra to Elmina for an (outrageous!!) price of $120. For a round trip, he charged $180. The price of a room for two was $65/night, which is really affordable for the quality and proximity to the resort. I definitely recommend this as the best place to stay in Elmina

Nie wieder!. Ich kenne das Hirsgarten seit den 80er Jahren. Der absolute Tiefpunkt ist leider jetzt erreicht. Die Badibeiz ist die Katastrophe schlechthin und eine absolute abzocke! Ein Gläschen Wein (1dl) und weil die Falsche grad zufällig leer geworden ist, eher weniger 10.- (2.- Depot) eigenes Glas mitbringen geht nicht da anscheinend die Kasse das nicht hinkriegt. Da bekommt man im Seeliker Bad den viel besseren Service und Qualität

Ein Glutofen im Sommer.... Das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis stimmt insgesamt. Allerdings gibt es im Sommer einen deutlichen Nachteil: Die Zimmer heizen sich stark auf und werden regelrecht zu Glutöfen. Dadurch ist erholsamer Schlaf in der Nacht kaum möglich. Öffnet man die Fenster zur Abkühlung, wird es – insbesondere in den Zimmern zur Durchgangsstraße bzw. Autobahn – sehr laut. Positiv hervorzuheben sind die großzügig geschnittenen Zimmer, die zudem über eine praktische Kochgelegenheit verfügen. Auch die große Parkgarage ist ein klarer Pluspunkt. Das Frühstück ist nichts Besonderes, aber völlig in Ordnung und ausreichend, um gut in den Tag zu starten

soirée entre amis. Nous avons passés une excellente soirée dans ce Bistro qui organisait un dîner/buffet ce soir là L'accueil, le service, l'équiupe de cuisine (qui officiait "en public"), tout ce monde était au p'tis soins d'un clientèle apparemment ravie car, en plus, nous étions "accompagné" par un Jazz Band remarquable (Schwane River Jazz Band). Une adresse à retenir si vous passés dans la région de Cham (peut-être faut-il réserver ???)

Umdenken vom Pächter wäre wünschenswert. Ich komme seid Jahren an diesen schönen Ort. Leider hat sich viel zum schlechten geändert mit dem neuen Pächter. Es werden in der Woche keine Speisen vor 17 Uhr angeboten. Damit wird aber geworben, das man hier kulinarisch verwöhnt wird! Sorry nein! Wenn man also als Familie einen Tag hier verbringen möchte hat man schlechte Karten was die Verpflegung angeht! Das schlimme ist wan wird erst vor Ort darauf hingewiesen. Also ich hoffe hier gibts bald ein umdenken
gutes Essen, tolles Ambiente. Das Essen und die Bedienung waren super, gute Weinempfehlung, schönes Ambiente. Wir hatten einen tollen Abend

Nicht unbedingt eine Reise wert. Cham ist eine Kleinstadt direkt am Zuger See gelegen. Vielleicht nicht unbedingt eine Reise wert, denn es ist eigentlich nichts geboten dort: Es gibt einen kleinen netten Park am Seeufer, wo man schön spazieren gehen kann. Ansonsten die üblich Auswahl an (schweizerisch teuren) Restaurants, ein paar wenige Hotels, sonst hab ich nichts erwähnenswertes entdeckt

Maximal Durchschnittlich. Vor vielen Jahren haben wir die Wasserwirtschaft kennengelernt und uns bei unserem letzten Besuch inCham voller Freude daran erinnert. Leider eine ziemliche Enttäuschung: sehr durchschnittliches Essen zu deftigen Preisen. Weil Feiertag war, haben wir reserviert und mussten feststellen, dass es am Nachmittag nur eine kleine Auswahl an Speisen gab. Das macht ja nichts, aber statt erwarteter regionaler Gerichte nur 0815 Schnitzel und Pullet Pork an Salat mit einer Kartoffel. Dafür, dass man mit Grill wirbt, waren die trockenen Fetzen Fleisch eine Frechheit und man musste sie auch im Salat suchen… Die Bedienung war sehr nett und bemüht und das Lokal ist auch echt schön. Aber wir werden nicht mehr herkommen

Supertolles Restaurant mit herrlichem Biergarten. Wir waren heute zum Mittagessen im Biergarten. Die Location ist supertoll direkt am Regen gelegen. Großer mehrteiliger Biergarten. Spitzenmäßiges Restaurant mit gemütlich/moderner Einrichtung. Die supernette Servicekraft Karina hat uns den Aufenthalt sehr angenehm gemacht. Überaus aufmerksam und sowas von echt freundlich. Mein Holzfällersteak war in der Karte gut beschrieben und so war es wirklich. Zart mit krossen Zwiebel, Speckwürfelchen, Speckscheibe und gut schmeckende Kartoffelhälften. Dazu eine selbstgemachte schmackhafte Soße und eine wunderbare selbstgemachte Kräuterbutter. Es gab nicht auszusetzen. Alles Top!!! Es war unser Erstbesuch. Dafür lohnt es sich nach Cham zu fahren

Frühstücksbuffet. Ich war Samstag beim Frühstücksbuffet, und leider war das Joghurt im Glas nicht mehr frisch. Ich habe die Bedienung darauf hingewiesen, und sie meinte, sie würde es weitergeben. Nach 15 Minuten war das Joghurt immer noch da, und es wurde nicht entfernt. Das fand ich sehr enttäuschend, gerade bei so einem Buffet

Nettes Städtchen als Tor zum Bayrischen Wald. Der Ort ist ein Oberzentrum am Rande des Bayrischen waldes. es hat alle annehmlichkeiten einer gro0en kreisstadt und verfügt über einen netten ortskern. besnderons im sommer schön wegen dem regen

Laid Back Local. Near my hotel and wanted to try local, which this place delivered. Relaxed outdoor dining in very casual atmosphere. Beers were cold. Every dish is the same price, 110 cedis. Went 3 times, and had a great goat dish, but when I returned, it was unavailable

enjoyed dinner with highlife music. Great live band, food, can be very busy when live band plays. We love their snail kebabs but mostly come for the music and dancing. kind owners, staff is ok, washrooms need improvement
Great Place for Food and Entertainment. It is a great place for live entertainment and great food. The service was excellent and the hosts/owners were friendly and made sure you were taken care of

Amazing food and wonderful host. We were looking for authentic local food and we really wanted to try Banku. They had several Banku options, I was undecided, so the lady serving us immediately offer to bring a little portion of the okra stew for me to try. It was just delicious! Everything! I highly recommend, and I’ll try to go again!
Terrible grilled tilapia. The grilled tilapia wasn’t nice one bit. We couldn’t enjoy our food. The fried plantain too was just a small portion. Very disappointed!
Good tilapia. I visited this restaurant after church with a couple of my friends. The food and service were good. I was told that they have live music at night
Lovely food place. Their food taste great. You should try them. They have a variety of dishes from African, European, Chinese, ITALIAN etc

Excellent place to eat in East Legon. I have had two enjoyable meals at this Restaurant now, today and yesterday. The food was excellent. Recommend the Tilapia and chicken dishes. Very generous portions and cooked well. Loved the ginger Sobolo - bissap drink. A nice cooling breeze passes through the Restaurant. But what made it for me was the friendly and attentive service. Special mention to Joyce who was so friendly and happy

Beer and nice music. Ordered the Banku with okra was horrible and far too tricky to eat with the bones in the fish etc....just overall not a pleasant experience. Music ok but could do better with hiring better waiters to chance the overall vibe. Beer was the highlight. A place more suited for groups than a solo eater/traveller like myself

Excellent Restaurant. Cadre convivial où l'on peut se restaurer entre amis à coûts acceptable. Leurs plats de poissons sont à vivement recommandés! Le service, quelque peu lent en temps d'affluence , demeure cependant assez bon

A very disappointing experience from a place I used to love,. I have been coming to Chez Clarisse for many years now every time I visit Ghana and had great experiences however something has changed significantly - and not for the better. Food took almost 2 hours to arrive and when it did only 1 out of the 3 meals we ordered were correct, despite us having long conversations with the waiter in the first instance. Several options on the menu were not available, including jollof rice! It seemed as if the waiter had just decided to replace our order with something different in the hope we would accept it after such a long wait. I will not be returning, sadly

Horrible experience in Accra / poor food and even poorer behaviour attached. Poor service and today even poorer food. I came several times this week because the food was too. But every single time the service was a disaster. The first day we waited 1h30 hour for the food to come, while ever 10 minutes the waiter was giving reassurances that the food is just 2/4. Minutes more. Every time we had to ensure the waiter understands the requests. Well, as it comes, the waiters - except one - do not understand the requests, don’t pay attention and are actually careless. Today we were told we will have to wait about 20 minutes. We waited 1 hours and 40 minures only to have very bad food coming. Hard chicken, uncooked rice, grilled banana instead of fried banana. Will never come back

What a disappointment.. What a disappointment. Place not busy and proprietor (Clarisse?) was away. Food was so slow and a family of three came in after us and were practically finished before we had our order. Server was slow and seemed to insist that we had a particular dish by repeatedly pointing at it on the menu. Menu was poorly laid out. No water in the toilets! (But water bowls on the table.) We both had very bad stomach sickness for the following 3+ days. Disaster. Would not recommend

Enttäuschend. Wir hatten Roasted goat und Fish Kebap bestellt. Geschmacklich war die Ziege hervorragend, größtenteils aber recht zäh. Als Fisch Kebab bekamen wir nur 2 Spieße, was für 100 cedi schon wenig ist. Als wir dann dafür aber 150 cedi zahlen sollten, haben wir uns die Karte geben lassen, dort waren 3 Spieße abgebildet, für 100 cedi. Die haben wir dann auch bezahlt, entschuldigt hat man sich aber nicht

Overpriced with bad service. Shocked at this experience, this place decided to increase their prices due to tourist in the country for festivities but didn’t care to upgrade their service. We ordered food for 4 people, after 30 min half of the food came and we had to wait another 30 for the other half. How can you serve main fish with no accompaniments and just let it go cold. No remorse whatsoever from the boss as she just ignored every table that had a complaint. Def not going here again

NEW STYLE - SAME GOOD FODD. My favorite place - even the new style might be more fancy and clean, but definitely not as cozy as before ;-( I miss the wooden trays the food was served in. Sobola is great
Not even there any longer. My wife and I wanted to have a lunch “Chez Clarrise”, but the place is torn down. They are “currently renovating”. When it will be back is anyone’s guess

Nice African outdoor setting.. Nice African outdoor setting. Be sure to wear something long to cover your legs if you’re going in the evening! The location was so easy to find since. I had acheke with grilled tilapia and my friend had their yam chips with grilled tilapia and avocados. The acheke was quite good but the stew was a little salty. Loved their grilled tilapia as well! The food is also very filling
Cozy place, friendly staff.. Cozy place, friendly staff. Food comes in time unlike other places. The music is good but the food is great

Delicious but outdoors!. I thought this was going to be a restaurant but actually it’s an outdoor courtyard and there’s a covered bit with fans. I was on my way to the airport so it got a bit sweaty as there’s no aircon! The food is fresh and delicious, I had tilapia and alloco (plantain). It’s cheap (50 cedi) although waiters can be a bit slow
Buka - marvelous dining experience. Don't miss it! Wonderful foods of Ghana, lovely environment, excellent value for experience!

Nice but very expensive. Buka has a wide range of traditional west African dishes served in an upmarket setting with upmarket prices. The vibe is nice, mostly tourists, and service was ok but not brilliant. Quite a few items not available in the evening which is surprising. Prices are high for what you get and then there are charges added when you get your bill. A waakye at the market will cost you C40, a nice soup and swallow at a decent eating place that’s more formal maybe C80. Here more like C200. It’s also not contemporary food - rather traditional dishes served. So if you want a more sanitized eating experience, go for it… but paying more isn’t getting you better quality or tastier food
Buka Accra. Very nice restaurant Very nice food and very good taste Thank you to Salam our waiter 🤩

ジョロフライスはオススメ。. ネットの口コミを見て行ってみました。事前に予約はしていませんでしたが、すぐに入店出来ました。店内はかなり賑わっていました。メニューはQRコードで読み取るタイプでした。店員さんにオススメを聞いてオーダーしましたが、ジョロフライスと魚は絶品でした。ナイジェリアで食べたジョロフライスと違って辛く無かったです。値段は少し高めですが、オススメのお店です。無料Wi-Fiもあります。

Overpriced and Overhyped!!. Went to this Buka restaurant this late afternoon with my son. I fancied Fufu, it was not the pounded fresh kind available, but packet fufu. I declined. Drinks there was not a single local drink in sight. We ended up with Campari as a starter drink. I ordered Banku with okra stew. Unavailable even though it was the Wednesday special.Went for Banku with okra soup. Turned up beautiful presented the bowl of soup and the Banku in a banana tree leaf. The Banku didn’t have the Banku taste, the slightly fermented after taste. Soup was nondescript and bland. The meat was AWFUL!! All 3 pieces of goat meat was mostly tough outer skin of the goat. Why will you assume I want to fight with my meat like that? At least add a piece of soft meat, which there was one but when I bit into had a smell like it was off! Didn’t eat that! The only thing worth mentioning was the wele in the soup. The extra fish I ordered was a tiny piece end of tail. Then the bill comes and there are 5 extra charges added to it. I asked why all these charges?!! Service charge at 16.5% NHL (whatever that is 2.5% Get Fund 2.5% Tourism Levy 1% VAT 15% Out total bill was 610ghs but we ended up paying an extra 165ghs for all these extras. My son’s Kontomire sauce was so water logged he had to tip water from it into the plate we had our kelewele starter before he ate it. Eaten at Buka a couple of years ago and it was nice food. Today’s experience was just terrible. My belly is a bit weak and I’m hoping it’s the okra and not the foul tasting piece of meat I ate. Shame!!

Horrible experience!. Service is not good, no manager around. When we arrived there was a table disputing charges. More than once we told the staff that we can’t eat any animal except fish and we wanted to make sure fish was not cooked in any animal broth. They assured us it is not. Halfway through the meal we discovered jelly beef skin in our fish dishes. They said all their dishes come with that…. Whatttttt!!! After they assured us something else. This was very traumatic experience and needless to say we left but the food made us sick. Mangament (in a locked door upstairs) tried ro blame it on the waiter. Definitely not his fault, but the owners of this place who have no respect for religion or ethics and put cow jelly in everything. It’s 2025… and you cater for international tourists, get a grip!

Uniquely African. The guide from our tour suggested this restaurant for dinner which was easy walking distance from our hotel, though there is parking available. We did not have a reservation, but had a table upstairs after waiting about 5 min. Menu was online and wifi password given in a sign at the bar. We enjoyed the atmosphere with plants hanging from the ceiling, energized music and friendly staff. Button on table to let staff know when you are ready to order. So much food as the servings are large. There is a hand-wash station as you enter the restaurant so you can eat with your fingers. Entrees and sides ordered separately. Well made dinner!

Hidden Gem 💎 Everything is delicious. Best Jollof Rice!!! I couldn't stop eating the delicious jollof rice. 😋 The artwork and decor was absolutely 💯 beautiful 😍 🤩 🇬🇭💗♥️💕 Delicious food, great service!!!

Awesome Food / BEWARE of the "EXTRA" costs on your bill!!!. The food was out of this world! Tremendous. The staff went above and beyond making great suggestions. I didn't love being charged A LOT extra on my bill. Added over 20$ USD to the bill so beware!! Extra charges for: Covid levy (yep), the VAT, tourism levy, GetFund, NHIL, and a service chare. OVER TWENTY Dollars. Ridic!!

The food was absolutely amazing. I absolutely loved the goat soup. Plus jollof rice was delicious.. The food was absolutely amazing. I absolutely loved the goat soup. Plus jollof rice was so delicious. If I should ever return to Ghana this will definitely be one of my favorite restaurants to revisit

Reminisce. I grew up in Osu Kuku hill, close to then Russian Cultural Centre. The places of interest are the Osu Night Market, the Castle, Independence Square, Oxford street, Regal Chinese Restaurant where authentic time immemorial Chinese food is served regularly and of course Frankie's

Beware of 'artist' Kwabena Adjei. Great spot, but beware of the artist named Kwabena Adjei, who tries to sell art and eventually becomes intimidating in collaboration with a child gang to give him huge amounts of money for art that impresses no one
Much fun. Many scrumptious foods and stores. Enjoy but there may be traffic. Osu is known for like a torrist attraction
想起了內羅畢的Westlands 區. 來到這裡讓我想起了內羅畢的Westlands 區。這是一個以繁忙的商業，餐廳和夜生活活動而聞名的社區。在其中一條街上，有超市和家電商店，美食和酒吧/夜總會。南端是奧蘇城堡的所在地。我建議遊客來這裡看看。要注意：小心貴重物品。避開小巷。太晚時最好有朋友陪同。買東西要討價還價。

See my Review of 'Oxford Street,' Osu.. This is a fascinating part of Accra, but it can be not a little rough. Go with a local friend who knows the city. All that you can expect of a city. Think of New Your's Soho or its namesake in London

An eye opener. For sure worth visiting just to take in the sights and smells.We did the walk from jamestown to Osu Castle, and it was a great beginning to our trip. it is hot, so make sure you buy plenty of pure water along the way and wear comfy shoes

HIGHLY COMMERCIAL AREA. Osu is one very popular location and busy area in Accra, with a busy night life. its also an highly commercial area where you can find various banks, offices, market, in fact you will get most indigenous arts and craft works of various good designs. Its also a location where you find several tourist visiting. Its also house one of the finest Nigerian local restaurant, popularly know as BUKA . Osu is a must to visit when you go to Accra Ghana

Backstreet real feel Accra. If you want to get a feeling for the real Accra hit the back streets of Accra. Find a little pub/shebeen and get involved with the locals. Don't be shocked by the hole in the wall that is the latrine which runs into the open sewers and smells rather rank. The people are welcoming but keep your eyes open
Intimate. I like osu because it is a small cramp community with a unique character. A town within a town. Lots of eateries, shops, and boutiques

Not worth a visit. We were told that Osu was the place to go shopping in Accra. So, we got an Uber to Oxford Street in Osu. Apart from a Shoprite supermarket and a couple of market stalls, we didn't see much else, so got another Uber to take us to Makola market. That's where you need to go

The missing Wasabi and Soy Sauce. The food was good, though I didn’t finish everything. I did order sushi to take home; however, they forgot to include soy sauce, wasabi, and ginger. I suppose they expected me to eat the sushi plain. Overall, it was a lovely experience, but the staff needs better training on how to properly pack to-go/takeaway orders. They should also be trained on how each meal is presented and what items typically accompany it or may be requested by customers. I would return, but I would definitely check my order thoroughly next time. Considering that a 10% service fee is automatically added to the bill, the level of service was lacking
Great food. This was a lovely place and the food and drink was excellent. Great service and overall ambience of the place was good. Will definitely come back again
Good Japanese. Great food and can never go wrong. Probably one of the finest Japanese in sub Sharan Africa. Staff could be a little more welcoming and show African hospitality

Cheating. Everything was ok before we got a receipt. The food was tasty and the cocktails as well. However, Aperol Spritz price was 350 ghs, what is more than 23 euro per 1 glass. To the question why it is so expensive, the waiter answered that they use a champagne for the cocktails. So, be careful and ask the price in advance

Wonderful!. My third visit here, but this time a la carte. Great salmon nigiri and sashimi. An extraordinarily beautiful spicy lobster miso. Rich, hot, bisque-like in its intensity. Hard to beat. Unusual and gorgeous tuna and foie gras sashimi. Crisp and lovely lobster tempura. Nice south african pinotage, a good Hennesy and great service with a chirpy and smiley Penelope running the House. Unctuous choc fondant and rich key lime pie . But..the highlight were pitch black bao buns( darkened with activated charcoal). Filled with melt-in-your mouth lamb and dressings. The best thing in months. A stonking 5 stars
Best sushi in town. Probably the best Sushi place in Town, unfortunately also the most expensive. Super location, always good parking, nice entourage, reasonable staff

Fantastisk restaurant. Utrolig god mat.. Fantastisk restaurant, atmosfæren og maten var vidunderlig. Magisk god sushi. Vi bestilte nigiri og noen uramaki - alle var utrolig gode. Fikk anbefalt hvitvin som passet perfekt. Anbefales på det sterkeste men må regne med at prisnivået er litt høyere. Vi mener det er verdt det

A must visit!. The drinks, ambience and service are all phenomenal. The ingredients are fresh, and the food is flavourful. The menu is well curated. Definitely try some sake too (I preferred mine chilled)
Fantastically good. The food was just excellent. The Japane lemonade is my favorite lemonade ever. The sushi was fantastically good and so fresh

Fresh, Hot, Tasteful. Food: I love shrimp/prawn tempura and when I ordered one serving, I was expecting only two pieces- not three! I was so happy. Then, I saw the size and took a bite. Sooo crunchy and good! They are LARGE! The prawn tempura is a MUST GET, 10/10, so much so, we ordered another to take home. We also ordered the home noodles with beef + chicken- 10/10, unagi sashimi 10/10, pork gyoza, 10/10, unagi roll, and prawn tempura roll 10/10. Everything was magnificent. Everything was hot and freshly delivered to us. The man course took a bit of time after our starters, but nonetheless, very fresh. Service: We were checked in on multiple times by different people through out the night. We felt seen, and taken care of. Very kind, respectful. Atmosphere: We went at night during the week, it is quiet and more intimate. The vibe at night is beautiful, and indoors is so pretty

If you’re not planning to order sushi, I recommend you go somewhere else.. If you plan to order from Rockefellas Continental cuisine offerings, I strongly suggest you dine somewhere else. Kitchen makes significant substitutions from what is defined in the menu without any communication. The meat was so overcooked, dry, and rock hard. Complained to person who took my order and she had no excuse and offered no remedy (totally disinterested)

Rocked this fella. Did my usual read-up here and Google on Rockefellas before visiting. Expected an ok meal in an ok restaurant. Surpassed my expectations . The waitress service was friendly, attentive and efficient. It was a fairly quiet friday night. Table inside was fine and near to the many staff. Had a Savannah. Wanted it v cold so they brought it in a bucket of ice. Good start. The gf has an Aphro passion cocktail. Palm wine and exotic juices- and very potent! Ordered sushi, sashimi and prawn tempura. The salmo and tuna sashimi was beautifully laid out. Eight pieces of each with soy, wasabi and ginger, cucumber etc. Nigiri was big with plump, packed and moist rice. Really good. The prawn tempura was outstanding! In all my travels and eating back in London, even in Japanese places, this was the biggest, sweetest prawn temoura with oodles of fluffy tempura crispy batter aroud huge prawns. Quite simply- the best ever. I went to the kitchen and told the tempura chef myself. A ghanaian lady. Probably bravado fuelled by a really lovely dark, bottle of Chocolate Pinotage from S.A. Gf was a bit full and ordered another round of tempura prawns for the main. I had flambed brandy steak with rich mushroom sauce and soft mash. Herein is where they dropped one star. I asked for medium rare but is was proper rare. I do eat such so had it all but could and probably should asked for it to be remade. It all tasted great , though. Naturally, all the alcohol and imported wine and huge Gh taxes bumped up the bill to a large 2700gh...£125 today. But, the drinks accounted for40% and the taxed 10%. If i was teetotal, way cheaper. Hsppily, i am not and the wine was excellent! The bill had my steak as medium -well, despite asking medium-rare. I got rare. So, sorry Guys. I give a 4. I would give 4.5 but you cannot. If you get your steak cook correct- and you have a dozen steaks on your menu- you get a 5. Overall, a brilliant start to 10 meals out in 10 nights here in Accra. Would 100% return

Birthday surprises. Went for birthday treat was amazing food and staff were excellent help me arrange a birthday surprise witch went very well the staff are very friendly and give it there best so I give them good tip

Nice food horrible hospitality unless your white / rich. I have just left this restaurant. I was here in April and the food is nice and the service ok. It is very expensive for Accra but I found the environment and food to be worth the spending. That was until today. I visited with two friends from abroad and when we arrived there was a birthday gathering. Now. We sat upstairs in the smoking area. When we arrived the music was a little loud but throughout our meal we ended up shouting at staff for drinks because they just couldn't hear us at all. After the 10th request to lower the music we spoke with the manager. She told us. Its a lounge so there is music. To which i responded I came for a meal. Why am I shouting at you for you to hear me. She basically said the birthday gathering is spending more money than our table so they are catering for them and if i wanted a restaurant I should have eaten downstairs! She felt that the music should be as loud as it is in a club because the other table were buying bottles and spent more money than we did. Talk about valuing your customers! Well that is if you plan on spending thousands. But. Lets only think about today!
Great food, better staff.. Sushi was fireeee! Chill atmosphere, great food and the staff called a cab for us when we were done, which was very nice of them

Very pleasant. So... I didn't have a reservation, but walked in on Christmas day with the family and within 5 minutes, we were seated I've been going to Rockefellas since they're were in Osu, so Im used to their high standards... This trip didn't disappoint either Pros Good food, lovely atmosphere, pleasant + professional staff Cons Drinks and food delayed somewhat, but they were quite full, so it's understandable Seems the the prices in the menu didn't tally with my receipt, but I guess it was the tax component. Had a brief chat with the owner (MP), nice chap, who as it turns out, is a F1 fan - perhaps we can schedule an F1 race viewing party at Rockefellas when the 2024 season starts One patron celebrated his birthday and the waiting staff rallied round to wish & sing him a happy birthday All in all, a very lovely experience. My rating for this visit is 5/5 👍👍
excellent. one of the best sushi restaurant in accra . clean food,,serene environment and lovely staff.they offer delivery services too

Beware!. The service was slow. The food was bland. They upsold and added charges to our checks. The prices presented on the menu were not the same as our checks. I ordered an entree that came with one side but I was still charged for the side

Really Nice. Pros... Great food, lovely service, decent atmosphere and reasonable prices. This was my first visit after they moved from Osu to Labone.... And to be honest, this location is much better Cons.. One of the air-conditioning units had broken down. Thankfully our hostess (Kate), told us about the faulty unit. Other than that, everything was on point. 4/5 for this visit

wonderfully pleasant. Went on a quiet night; found this place accidentally but what a nice surprise. Food I thought was really good and reasonably priced The cheesecake was the highlight of dinner 10/10 We were served by Ibrahim - who was most attentive & well mannered which made this entire trip even more memorable. On my list of restaurants to return to when I’m back to Accra !

Lovely unique spot.. The food was very good and had several options that are untraditional Ghanaian - which is a nice change. There are lots of options. Everything we had was terrific. The wait staff was lovely and very flexible. I must stay the elderflower spritz was really amazing. Definitely worth going

Good but pricy. Good food, but for that price level I wouldn't expect anything else. neat and organized, service not great, but super location. mostly expats. I am not a fan of restaurant food mixed with snack bar food, but that seems to be the fashion lately

Food Poisoning. My girlfriend and I had dinner the night before her return to the US. She opted for the penne and I had the seafood pasta. She ended up with incessant vomiting and diarrhea while I had the latter. We suspect the poisoning was from her dish (I had a bit of her food). She boarded her Delta flight the next morning’s all sleepless, worn-out, and dehydrated with the fear of more vomiting and diarrhea. It was a most unpleasant experience and we will not be going back!

The food made us SO SICK - beware!!. I was excited to eat here with my boyfriend after having an amazing meal with friends about 15 months ago. I ordered the salmon pasta and my boyfriend ordered the seafood pasta. We arrived around 9 pm so I'm not sure how the food was prepared and maintained that day. However, I got the WORST food poisoning about an hour after eating - literally vomiting, diarrhea, and fevers all night and throughout the next day. My boyfriend had just a bite of my food so he had similar symptoms but less severe. As a medical professional, I could identify this was clearly a classic case of Staphylococcus Aureus food poisoning - meaning the creamy salmon pasta was not maintained at a proper temperature and likely reheated prior to serving. I will NEVER come back here again! There are better places to eat in Accra that won't make you sick

You won’t regret it. I come to this place often for my usual the paesto pasta with chicken followed by their glorious apple crumble with ice cream. Sometimes I dream about ordering the food because it is so nice. Nice atmosphere. The service can be a little bit and miss here however in general it’s quite good and is one of the best places in Ghana for service to be honest with you. Staff can be a little less attentive at times. The food is nice. I have tried I think it’s the beef tacos. I am bias because I stick to my favourite one of these days I will brunch out

Muy buena cocina. Excelente calidad en la cocina, local bonito, buen servicio y atención, pero creo que les falta formación porque estaban un poco perdidos algunos camareros. Los vinos demasiado caros

First Finer Dining Stop after being away from Ghana for a Year. Sat at bar and Eric was busy initially but took order very efficiently and beverages, entree and dessert were outstanding. Flor the manager sat with me a bit asking how my experience was even though she shared she will be moving on shortly (very committed
Toptent. Toptent Lekker bier goed eten en superaardig bediening Op de grote markt verwacht je alleen maar toeristische ellende maar dit restaurant is de moeite waard

Great Place for Western Good Quality Food in Accra. We came twice in five weeks as we came into and out of Ghana. The place has amazing food and great service. The place is not cheap but worth every penny you spend. We had two dinners there and we loved it

Nice with a Variety of Food Choices and a Cool Crowd. Super chill environment with good food and decent prices. The vibe is good and diverse with a very attentive staff. Kid friendly space with a grown up crowd. It seemed to be a great place to host a personal party - great space for a birthday on the patio area
Nothing special. Nothing special, food was average, service good. Atmosphere kind of sterile. Entered the Deck thru a darkened restaurant that was not open?

Excellent meal. We went on a Rediscover Barbados special deal. This turned out to be incredible value for money for the quality of food we were served. Other restaurants on the scheme had downgraded the promised menus, not here. Would definitely go back

Nice waterfront location.. Have been there before for dinner good selection when all is available, most restaurants run out of items readily so be patient. At beach edge with ocean views,pricing up there and good portions. Daily happy hour 5-7 pm helps keep the cost down. Will return next year again. Service was good

Breakfast choices. We had breakfast at the hotel expensive continental or buffet or you can order from the menu. We choice the continental as we were not that hungry and wanted a light breakfasts. It offers cereal, fresh fruit and breads toast and sweet items. Buffet offers the same plus hot food choices. Food here is on the pricy side. All was good. Service was excellent

Yvonne. Today I was taken to your establishment for my birthday,and I met a lovely and wonderful staff member by the name of Yvonne . She was very professional in all aspects of her job and made us felt that we were the most precious visitors to your restaurant,her smile and delivery of service was so great . I am very please to be personal served by this wonderful lady and I am sure that she has been a valuable asset to your establishment . I am very please with the service I sgot and the manner in which it was performed . More over her shift was finish but she stayed on to ensure that she could sing the birthday song to me .i am please to be recommending your Restuarent ans Ynonne to my friends as the greatest place to visit .Thanks for making my day Yvonne
Tuesday night great food. Top chef cooks delicious food, amazing band. Great atmosphere , worth the money, top notch cuisine 👨‍🍳👋

the best dining experience by far in the whole of barbados. if i could eat there every night i would. it is average price but the food and waiter service is the fantastic. i did not expect this from an average hotel but wow what a meal. Thanks chef

Great dinner with a view. This restaurant is in the Accra hotel and I wasn’t sure what to expect. It is outdoor so the sounds of the waves is soothing as you have a glass of wine and relax for a quiet dinner Service is good and the food was delicious. Smaller portions which is great so you are not leaving to full
Great 3 course meal. I must say a very impressive fine dinning meal. The highlight was the fish and stake meals. And the best italian motlen lava cake every. Small portion sizes but filling

Convenient Location, Sea view. We stayed at Accra Beach Hotel and Spa during a recent family vacation and we ate at Accra Deck for dinner on the first night. The food was great and the service excellent as well. They also serve breakfast and we had breakfast there a few mornings and the prices are fairly expensive. Whilst they are also open for lunch we did not have the opportunity to try. It was great to enjoy the experience overlooking the beach with the gentle sea breeze

Be ware!. If you happen to be getting here late, kindly get some snacks or food outside before you get in. If not you will be told the restaurant is closed. Even the usual Milo or tea bags hotels of this status place in the room for any eventuality, you will not find. The front desk is clueless. You will only be told the house keepers have closed so unless the next day before they can bring you anything. Well, you only have to sleep hungry. No help, not bothered at all

145% increase in curry in less than three months. They seem to have lost the plot with their prices, the first beef curry takeaway I bought was GHS185 and not less then two months later they have put the price up by 145% to the GHS269 for the same meal. Food is great by at that price I won't be buying here again

Terrific stay in Kumasi at Frederick’s Lodge. Great stay at Frederick’s Lodge in Kumasi. The property is clean, safe and well maintained. The best thing however is the kind and attentive staff. We particularly appreciated the help of Emanual, Francis and Kathryn. Emanual made sure we were able to have an early breakfast when we needed to get on the road and even brought breakfast to the rooftop lounge for us in the morning. A terrific first class experience. We’ll be back
Fijne plek. Wat hebben we genoten van het verblijf bij BWO hostel. Fijne kamers, mooie tuin, heerlijk eten en lieve mensen. We hadden de 3 daagse Ashanti tour geboekt. Een aanrader met gids Ike

Comfort, Convenience & Excellent Value. My stay at Oak Plaza Hotel Suites was a wonderful experience. Its convenient location, close to the airport and my meeting venue, made getting around effortless. The serene, welcoming atmosphere, along with the aesthetically pleasing and cozy rooms, made for a comfortable and relaxing stay. Overall, it offers excellent value for money, and I would gladly recommend it to anyone seeking comfort, convenience, and quality
Great time. Spacious room with excellent room service. The place is serene and lovely to stay I recommend to anyone looking forward to have an unforgettable and a good stay 1

Excellent Accommodations Combined with Outstanding Customer Service made for an Enjoyable Stay!. Our travel group of 35 people stayed 3 nights at the Asantewaa Premier Hotel in Kumasi during our cultural expedition of Ghana in June 2026. Despite the size of our group, the staff never missed a beat. Their “all hands on deck” teamwork made our stay consistently comfortable. From the welcoming front desk to the thoughtful concierges, the efficient bellman, the dependable security team, and the wonderfully friendly restaurant staff, it was clear we were in good hands. This was Ghanaian hospitality at its finest, the kind that makes you feel instantly at home. We were fortunate to have one of the apartments. It was clean and spacious. We had no issues with the hot water, the TV and connecting to the internet. While there were many outstanding staffers, we must give a ‘shout out’ to Bright. He was one of several staffers that helped our group with luggage. I also saw him at the front desk and restaurant during our stay. He is reflective of the type of customer service we experienced. If you’re looking for a place to stay in Kumasi, the Asantewaa Premier Hotel is a property that we highly recommend!

memos hotel Kumasi. beautiful place, friendly staff, myself and my girlfriend had a few issues 1 was the pool as we had a storm and the pool was dirty and couldn't be used for 4 days, it should have been sorted quicker. and be aware if your a tourist and you order from the restaurant they charge 1% of the bill as a tourism tax which I think is wrong my girlfriend even asked about it on the feedback form but no reply yet

heimliche Hauptstadt. Der letzte ghanaische Präsident wollte Kumasi sogar zur Hauptstast machen. Der Druck, es bei Accra zu belassen war aber doch zu groß. In der Stadt gibt es etliche Sehenswürdigkeiten. Hotels aller Preisklassen, superschnelles Internet neben der Hauptpost und auch in der näheren Umgebung etliches zu besichtigen. Die Stadt selbst wird vom riesigen, häßlichen und dreckigen Markt geprägt

Kumasi, the Most Interesting Ghana City that We Visited. Note that a visit to any part of Ghana is an opportunity for immersion in a different culture. This is the real reason to go. We visited three areas in Ghana and Kumasi was the most interesting of all. This is in the Ashante (Ashinti) area rich in history which you can see in museums and cultural displays. Interesting markets and one-person salespersons are everywhere. Be prepared to negotiate prices. This can be exhausting. We would not go there without a good guide. See our comments on Accra for our recommendation

THE BEST Cape Coast Sights & Historical Landmarks to Visit (2026)Cape Coast, Ghana, is a historically rich coastal city.. Originally built by Sweden in 1653 (as Carolusborg) and later expanded by the British, this "slave castle" held thousands of captive Africans in brutal dungeon conditions before they were forced through the infamous "Door of No Return" to the Americas

A must-see UNESCO site, full of history. We toured Cape Coast Castle on a recent visit to Ghana.
